Absolum - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition – Launch Trailer
Play Absolum - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition now: https://ninten.do/6001adCnT

Play as the outcast heroes of Talamh, explore dangerous lands, battle brutal bosses, unlock powerful upgrades, and uncover the mystery of Azra's absolute magical power! 

Absolum - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition runs at 60 fps for smoother gameplay, has improved resolution, and lets you play with Gameshare locally. Nintendo Switch players will be able to upgrade to the Switch 2 version for free while keeping their earned progression and saved games! 

Will you defy the Sun King and change the fate of this world?

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Play LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6002aZvO6

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is a brand-new open world action-adventure video game that invites players to embark on Bruce Wayne’s epic journey to become the hero of Gotham City. Forge a new family of allies with Jim Gordon, Catwoman, Robin, Nightwing, and Batgirl, and confront an ever-growing threat as you face The Joker, The Penguin, Mr. Freeze, Poison Ivy, Bane, and more. 

Inspired by decades of Batman films, television, comic books, and games, LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is jam-packed with Batman nostalgia, DC lore, and TT Games’ signature brand of fun-filled LEGO humor! 

#LEGOBatmanGame
